title: Routine Work the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans Carry Without a Claim
content:
**What does a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans carry besides claims?** Chain and clasp work is included on the coverage that lists it and is otherwise priced as ordinary bench work at the workshop counter. Once the included count for a service is used up in the rolling twelve months, further work of that kind is priced as ordinary bench work and is not refused.

**Does routine work eat into the benefit allowance?** No. Routine services consume no benefit allowance, so a plan whose allowance is exhausted still carries its included services until the term runs out.

**What happens when the included count runs out mid-year?** The work is still carried out; it is priced as ordinary bench work at the counter. Nothing in this basis refuses the customer the work.

## Clauses no longer in force

The two clauses below are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current basis. They are kept here so that withdrawn law is not applied; the counts of replating, resizing, refinishing and goodwill visits each plan includes remain as the schedules publish them.

> Coverage includes a set number of routine services in a rolling twelve months — replating, resizing and refinishing — and these are drawn without a claim being opened.

> A service visit that falls outside what the coverage includes may be handled as goodwill up to the coverage's goodwill allowance, and the goodwill visit is recorded like any other so the allowance can be counted.
